purpose: Read the minimum campaign-selected Android Health Connect records into a bounded raw export, then transform locally inside BODY / FIT into existing sensor-observation envelopes without creating a second health store or writing imported data back to Health Connect.

boundary.runtime: Minimal native Android source lives at /android/body-bridge/; BODY / FIT static web surface owns the raw-export → canonical observation transform.
boundary.default_transport: BODY BRIDGE explicit local 0xxx0/health-connect-export/v0.1 JSON -> BODY / FIT import -> /body/fit/health-connect-transform.js -> 0xxx0/body-sensor-bundle/v0.1
boundary.future_transport: private local relay / HOUSEBUS / Hermes only if it reduces friction without broadening authority

laws: ASK ONLY FOR RECORD TYPES REQUIRED BY AN ACTIVE CAMPAIGN.
DATA ORIGIN + DEVICE + RECORDING METHOD SURVIVE TRANSFORM.
NO PERSONAL HEALTH VALUES IN THE PUBLIC REPOSITORY.
DO NOT WRITE THIRD-PARTY READ DATA BACK INTO HEALTH CONNECT.

first_proof.goal: Prove one night of sleep-session metadata plus heart-rate lineage can cross the boundary locally with source identity intact.

observations.result: duration minutes computed from source startTime/endTime
observations.note: FIELD computes duration from a source interval; retain original start/end and stage payload in provenance/context rather than pretending duration is a direct measurement.

observations.result: one source sample per observation for first proof; later batching may be a projection only
exercise type + source interval; duration may be projected explicitly

provenance_map.source_class: WEARABLE when device/source evidence supports wearable origin; otherwise IMPORT/PHONE as appropriate rather than guessed
provenance_map.phenomenon_time: source record/sample effective time or explicit start/end interval representation
provenance_map.source_ref: Health Connect record id when locally retained

permission_strategy.revoke_behavior: Loss/revocation becomes explicit unavailable/unknown state; it does not synthesize zeros or silently expand permissions.

next_proof: Compile the minimal Android BODY BRIDGE source against current Health Connect/AGP.
Import it into BODY / FIT and verify timestamps, source app/device attribution, units and missingness survive.
Then decide whether an automatic local relay is worth its dependency cost.

native_export.content: selected raw Health Connect record fields + provenance only
native_export.aperture: last 48h SleepSessionRecord; HeartRateRecord only inside returned sleep intervals for first proof

automated_proof.non_claim: Compile/fixture proof does not prove real phone permissions, Samsung Health sync, source population, or a personal round trip.
